title: Share “{name}”
description: Choose who can open this board, who runs its sessions and whether there's a public link.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
people.empty: No one has been added besides the owner. Team members still see the team's boards.
people.noCandidates: Everyone in the workspace already has access
people.inviteByEmail: Invite someone from outside by email
facilitators.intro: Facilitators run the timer, voting, Private Mode and protected locks. The owner and admins are facilitators already.
facilitators.openBoard: Open the board to pick its facilitators (the list is saved with the board's content).
facilitators.empty: No one else edits this board. Give editor access in the People tab to pick facilitators.
link.off: Off — only people with access can open it
link.maxLifetime_one: The workspace policy limits links to {count} day.
link.maxLifetime_other: The workspace policy limits links to {count} days.
link.passwordPlaceholder: Set a password for the link
link.passwordSet: Password set — type a new one to change it
link.localPasswordNote: In local mode, the password only truly protects the board once there's a server: the data stays in this browser.
link.downloadCeiling: The workspace policy doesn't let visitors export — no link can allow it.
link.neverUsed: No one has opened this link yet
gate.passwordText: Whoever shared the link set a password. Type it to open the board as a visitor.
gate.expiredText: The link's time is up. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
gate.revokedText: Whoever shared it turned this link off for good.
gate.disabledText: This board's public link isn't active right now.
gate.policyText: The workspace policies don't allow this link to be opened right now.
gate.invalidText: Check the address. In local mode, the link only works in the browser where the board was created.
gate.localNote: Local mode: the link opens the data stored in this browser. Access for other people over the network arrives with the server.
noAccess.title: No access to this board
banner.visitor: You're here as a visitor through the public link ({level} access).
link.onceNote: This link's address is shown only when it's created: the server keeps just a fingerprint of it. Lost it? Generate a new link (the old one stops working).
link.regenerateToCopy: Generate a new link to copy
